sloka: स मां दृष्ट्वा महाबाहुर्वितुन्नां स्तनयोस्तदा ।आशीविष इव क्रुद्धः श्वसन् वाक्यमभाषत ।। ५.३८.२५।।।।
transliteration: sa māṁ dṛṣṭvā mahābāhurvitunnāṁ stanayostadā ।āśīviṣa iva kruddhaḥ śvasan vākyamabhāṣata ।। 5.38.25।।।।

translations.english: 'O strongarmed Rama, seeing my torn breasts, you became angry like a hissing serpent and hissing said :
